definitions.explanation: The underlying logic or natural principle that makes something the way it is.
Used as an adverb (道理で) to express that something now makes sense in light of new information.

examples.japanese: {道理|どうり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わない→合う：10466_au⟧。
{子|こ}ども⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧{道理|どうり}だ。
examples.english: It's a principle even a child can understand.

examples.japanese: {道理|どうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦わきまえた→わきまえる：15928_wakimaeru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
examples.english: They're a person who understands reason.

examples.japanese: {道理|どうり}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧わけだ。
{道理|どうり}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}ったら→思う：00492_omou⟧、⟦{入院|にゅういん}していた→入院する：01849_nyuuinsuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: No wonder I hadn't heard from them — they were in the hospital.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。{道理|どうり}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦{見|み}かけない→見かける：01644_mikakeru⟧わけだ。
examples.english: So they moved. No wonder I haven't seen them around lately.

notes:
{道理|どうり} has two main uses: as a noun meaning "reason" or "logic," and as part of the adverbial expression {道理|どうり}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ meaning "no wonder."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {道理|どうり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: to make sense, to be reasonable
- {道理|どうり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わない→合う：10466_au⟧: to be unreasonable, illogical
- {道理|どうり}で〜わけだ: no wonder ~
- {道理|どうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦わきまえる→わきまえる：15928_wakimaeru⟧: to understand reason

USAGE: The expression {道理|どうり}で〜わけだ is very common in everyday conversation. It conveys a moment of realization — something that was puzzling now makes sense.
